name: Marisol, 31
tagline: Urban planner who sketches strangers on the train (flatteringly).

prompts.answer: Farmers market, a long walk with no destination, then cooking something ambitious that half-works.
Why some streets feel alive and others feel dead. I will point at benches. You've been warned.

name: Devon, 34
tagline: ER nurse, half-marathoner, aggressively normal about fantasy novels.

prompts.answer: I've delivered a baby in a parking lot. I cried at a car commercial. I've read Wheel of Time twice. (The lie is that it was only twice.)

name: June, 29
tagline: Ceramicist with a day job in data. My mugs are load-bearing.

prompts.prompt: You should not go out with me if…
prompts.answer: You need someone who texts back fast. I make things with my hands and forget my phone exists. It's a feature.

name: Theo, 36
tagline: High school physics teacher. Yes, I will explain the demo. No, it's not dangerous. Mostly.

prompts.answer: Chalk dust, the first sip of coffee during first period silence, and students who argue with me correctly.

name: Ravi, 32
tagline: Startup person in recovery; now I build furniture and sleep eight hours.

prompts.prompt: The way to win me over is…
prompts.answer: Ask me what I'm making. Then tell me what you're making. Everyone is making something.

name: Anouk, 27
tagline: Wildland firefighter half the year, couch scientist the other half.

prompts.answer: Either digging a fire line on a ridge at dawn or watching six hours of deep-sea documentaries. There is no in-between.

name: Sam, 38
tagline: Dad of one great kid. Bakes bread badly on purpose (crust practice).

prompts.answer: Kindness to waitstaff, showing up when you said you would, and letting me have Saturday mornings with my daughter.

name: Kaia, 30
tagline: Marine biologist. Will absolutely ruin octopus documentaries with facts.

prompts.answer: Cephalopod cognition. An octopus once judged me through glass and honestly? Fair.

name: Elena, 35
tagline: Immigration lawyer, choir alto, keeper of a chaotic group chat.

prompts.answer: Four-part harmony landing exactly right, and the specific silence in a courtroom right before good news.

name: Finn, 28
tagline: Line cook turned pastry apprentice. Smells like butter, will not apologize.

prompts.prompt: The way to win me over is…
prompts.answer: Eat the weird thing on the menu with me. Both weird things. All of them.

name: Priya, 31
tagline: Product manager who actually likes her job (suspicious, I know). Trail runner.

prompts.answer: Ten miles of trail before nine, then absolutely nothing but a couch and a very long book.

name: Oskar, 40
tagline: Woodwind repair tech. I fix the thing your kid stepped on before the recital.

prompts.answer: Church on Sunday, dinner at the table, and patience — with instruments and with people.

name: Zee, 26
tagline: Grad student in linguistics. Will notice how you say 'caramel' and say nothing (out loud).

prompts.answer: Why your grandmother's dialect is a national treasure and duolingo's owl is a cop.

name: Noor, 33
tagline: Pediatric OT, community garden co-lead, human golden retriever energy.

prompts.answer: Tiny humans throwing beanbags at me for therapeutic reasons, then watering tomatoes that belong to forty households.
